title: More to Come
message: Thank you for every month, every memory, and every problem na nalalampasan natin together. For me, it’s been a beautiful and perfect journey, and I know marami pa tayong haharapin at malalampasan together. Thank you for always being there, especially when I’m busy or stressed. Thank you for your patience, understanding, and for always waiting for me. Looking back at how we started and all the memories we’ve made, I’m truly grateful I got to experience them with you. Hindi ko man alam kung ano ang naghihintay sa atin, I know I want to keep making memories with you. Thank you for staying, loving me, and choosing me. Mahal na mahal kita. This is only the beginning of our story.

epilogue.title: Happy Anniversary
epilogue.message: I’m grateful for every moment, every memory, and every challenge we faced together. I’m excited for all the memories we have yet to make. I love you so much, always..
